core_obligations: Use commutation with stalks and pullbacks to reduce to the stalk at one geometric point (proof lines 4840-4844).
Identify C as a henselization of A tensor_R B and apply the localization results to compute L_{C/R} (proof lines 4845-4847).
Express the stalk of E as the cone of the map L_{A/R} tensor C -> L_{A tensor_R B/R} tensor C (proof lines 4848-4849).
Conclude with the ring case of the computation (proof lines 4850-4851).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms X -> B and Y -> B of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the object E of the fibre product equation has vanishing cohomology in degrees 0 and -1, and at a geometric point of X x_B Y the degree -2 cohomology is Tor_1^R(A,B) tensor_{A tensor_R B} C with R, A, B, C the respective etale local rings (source lines 4825-4838). The proof uses that the formation of the cotangent complex commutes with stalks and pullbacks, that C is a henselization of A tensor_R B, and that the localization results of the chapter give L_{C/R} = L_{A tensor_R B/R} tensor C, so that the stalk of E is the cone of the map L_{A/R} tensor C -> L_{A tensor_R B/R} tensor C; the statement is then reduced to the ring case.
